mainEntity.name: What is an online form builder?

acceptedAnswer.text: Formester is an AI powered online form builder that helps you create forms, surveys, quizzes, and workflows without coding. You can collect responses, automate tasks, and integrate forms with your favorite tools.
Yes. Formester offers a free plan that lets you create and share forms with essential features. You can upgrade anytime for advanced automation, integrations, and higher usage limits.

mainEntity.name: How is Formester different from Google Forms or Typeform?

acceptedAnswer.text: Formester offers advanced features like AI form generation, conditional logic, payment collection, automation, and deeper integrations that go beyond basic form tools like Google Forms and Typeform.

mainEntity.name: Can I create forms using AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Formester’s AI form builder helps you generate complete forms from simple prompts. You can then customize fields, logic, and design using an easy drag and drop editor.

mainEntity.name: Can I collect payments through forms?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can create payment forms to collect fees, orders, and subscriptions using secure payment integrations. Formester supports flexible payment collection and automation.

mainEntity.name: Does Formester integrate with other tools?

acceptedAnswer.text: Formester integrates with popular tools like Google Sheets, Zapier, CRMs, email platforms, and more to automate workflows and manage data efficiently.

mainEntity.name: Is Formester secure for collecting data?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Formester uses secure infrastructure and data protection practices to keep your form submissions safe and protected.
Formester is designed for businesses, marketers, HR teams, educators, startups, and creators who want to build smart forms and automate data collection without coding.

mainEntity.name: Do I need coding skills to use Formester?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Formester is a no code online form builder with an intuitive drag and drop interface that lets you create and automate forms easily.

mainEntity.name: Can I customize the design of my forms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can fully customize your forms to match your brand using themes, layouts, colors, and field settings to create professional forms.

heading.text: What our users say about Formester

testimonials.name: Deanna Bugalski
testimonials.comment: I was searching for a long time for a product I could use to send newsletters and surveys to my database. I tried so many different types of software and I found many of them difficult to use and slow to learn how to operate. But Formester was super easy to set up, and the usability is seamless! I highly recommend!

testimonials.name: Costanza Casullo
testimonials.comment: Formester is simple enough for non-developers and sophisticated enough for developers. I'd say being able to choose between simplicity and complexity is one of this product's strengths. In addition, the founder is available to answer questions and doubts, which does not happen every day.

testimonials.name: Thibaud Martinez
testimonials.comment: I really enjoy Formester. It’s clean and straight-forward and it does well, what it is supposed to do.

testimonials.name: Dr. Michele Ross
testimonials.comment: I'm migrating my forms from Paperform, where I've been a user for over 4 years. Loving the software so far! I've already replaced Paperform form embeds & popups on my sites & my husband's websites with Formester forms

testimonials.name: Jilson
testimonials.comment: Formester is really easy to use and an exceptional alternative for Typeform. We use it for call for papers, lead registrations, feedback and surveys and it cannot be simpler.

testimonials.name: Bency
testimonials.comment: Formester's AI form generator transformed how quickly we build forms. The drag-and-drop builder paired with AI-generated templates means I can spin up a survey or poll in minutes, not hours. Conditional logic, file uploads, and seamless integrations make it incredibly versatile and the customization options let every form match our branding perfectly. Their support team is exceptional too. It's the only form and survey tool we recommend

testimonials.name: Bob
testimonials.comment: We have been in business for over thirty years and were never happy with our forms until we found Formester. Now, we have clients actually enjoying completing and submitting online forms. If you are looking for a platform to create online forms... look no further – Formester is the best. Your clients will thank you!

testimonials.name: Alex
testimonials.comment: Tried like 4 quiz tools for our lead gen funnel before this and honestly this is the only one I didn't end up hating. AI did most of the work and the customization actually works.

testimonials.name: Chris
testimonials.comment: Very intuitive and the surveys look genuinely professional out of the box. Most importantly, I requested a custom rating scale and they shipped it within hours. Stellar support that is hands-down better than the Jotform.

testimonials.name: Roger
testimonials.comment: I use Formester for my form-building needs and I’m thoroughly impressed. The platform is rich with features… What really sets them apart is their exceptional customer service (responses typically within 10 minutes). The pricing is also very reasonable… Highly recommended!

testimonials.name: Ye Qi Lai
testimonials.comment: Formester is one of the best underrated survey tools out there… It’s extremely customizable… Their support is awesome… I absolutely recommend this to anyone looking for an alternative to the usual form creators.
